subject: Human Evolution
title: Mammoth Hunters
description: A quick win: understand Mammoth Hunters.

hook.text: A woolly mammoth weighs six tons. How do you kill something ten times your size with stone-tipped spears?

buildup.text: Drive it into a swamp, box it against a cliff, or wound it and track it for days until it weakens.

discovery.text: Group tactics, landscape knowledge, and patience compensated for inferior individual strength.

twist.text: Some researchers think most mammoth kills were opportunistic—sick, young, or already trapped animals.

climax.text: Either way, a single mammoth provided tons of meat, fat, bone, and hide—a mobile warehouse.

punchline.text: One mammoth fed a band for weeks.

quiz.question: How did ice age humans hunt mammoths?
options: Group tactics using terrain and persistence
